_notes: Named things wrong with a parish in particular (DESIGN §8.7). Every parish rolls two to four at generation, weighted by what it is: no two parishes play the same. Content gates scenes on the issue id or on what it touches; the Parish sheet lists them in the pastor's own words.

issues.label: The 1961 school wing
issues.blurb: The wing built in 1961 has asbestos in the pipe lagging, which everybody has known since 1998 and nobody has costed.

issues.label: The boiler
issues.blurb: The boiler is older than the pastor and is kept alive by a parishioner who is seventy-eight and will not always be here.

issues.label: The sanctuary roof
issues.blurb: There is a stain over the sanctuary that is bigger than it was in the spring, and two contractors have given two answers.

issues.label: The organ
issues.blurb: The 1924 organ has four dead ranks and a rebuild quoted at the price of a small house.

issues.label: The car park easement
issues.blurb: Half the car park belongs, on paper from 1957, to the family that owns the hardware store, and the third generation has begun to read the paper.

issues.label: The parish cemetery
issues.blurb: The cemetery has eleven plots left and four families who assume they have one.

issues.label: The shrine in the north corner
issues.blurb: A devotion nobody at the chancery has heard of, a statue somebody's grandmother brought from the old country, and forty people who would leave over it.

issues.label: Two choirs who do not speak
issues.blurb: The nine o'clock choir and the eleven o'clock choir have not been in the same room since 2004 and both believe they are the parish's.

issues.label: The festival's money
issues.blurb: The summer festival takes in cash, has always taken in cash, and the committee has never in forty years shown anybody a ledger.

issues.label: The Fahey bequest
issues.blurb: A bequest from 1988 that pays out yearly and may only be spent on something the will describes in language nobody now understands.

issues.label: The housekeeper's flat
issues.blurb: The housekeeper of thirty years lives in the flat, does very little now, and cannot be moved without a scandal.

issues.label: The school's numbers
issues.blurb: The school has room for four hundred and teaches a hundred and eleven, and the subsidy is the largest line in the budget.

issues.label: What the school pays
issues.blurb: The teachers are paid eleven thousand less than the public district and three of the good ones are being courted.

issues.label: The neighborhood
issues.blurb: The families who built this church moved out to the county thirty years ago and drive back for the nine o'clock, and the people who live here now are not in the pews.

issues.label: The parish three miles away
issues.blurb: Three miles away is a parish with a better choir, a younger pastor, and forty of your families in its pews.

issues.label: The developer
issues.blurb: Somebody wants the convent building, which has been empty since 2007, and has begun writing to the chancery rather than to you.

issues.label: The man who was here before
issues.blurb: The previous pastor was here twenty-two years and is spoken of in the present tense.

issues.label: What the last man left
issues.blurb: The previous pastor left in a hurry and a way nobody will describe, and the parish flinches at things you cannot predict.

issues.label: The Sunday afternoon group
issues.blurb: Eleven families drive in from three parishes for something the last pastor allowed and the chancery would rather not hear about.

issues.label: The chairman of the council
issues.blurb: The parish council's chairman has been its chairman since 1996 and regards the pastor as a tenant.

issues.label: The other Mass
issues.blurb: The community that fills the noon Mass has no representation on anything that decides anything.

issues.label: The food pantry
issues.blurb: The pantry serves four times what it was built for, out of a basement with one working sink and volunteers in their seventies.

issues.label: The bells
issues.blurb: The bells have not rung since the motor failed, and half the parish has not noticed and the other half mentions it weekly.

issues.label: The undercroft floods
issues.blurb: The undercroft takes water twice a year now where it used to take water twice a decade.

issues.label: The books
issues.blurb: The books were kept for eleven years by a volunteer who has died, in a system he did not write down.

issues.label: The school board
issues.blurb: Four of the seven on the school board are related, and the principal is the fifth's sister-in-law.
